policy.note: Operational heuristics, not validated probabilities of listener enjoyment or evidence of causal improvement.

variations.label: Guitar-led solo
variations.direction: Rhythmic acoustic guitar foreground, warm piano support, buoyant bass and restrained drums. Choose a clear lead register appropriate to the passage.

variations.label: Alternating duet
variations.direction: Distinct male and female singers alternate suitable passages; selective simultaneous harmony. Save role assignments and avoid echoing scripture by default.

variations.label: Piano-led solo with dynamic arc
variations.direction: Bright rhythmic piano foreground, quiet guitar accents, clear solo lead, lighter dense passage and a fuller final lift.

variations.label: Scripture refrain and responses
variations.direction: Full chapter with an exact scripture phrase returning as a refrain; supporting responses and harmony where useful. Save the explicit performance lyrics and allowed repetitions before generation.

variations.label: Suno-led composition
variations.direction: Give V6 freedom over melody, groove, instruments and singers within warm buoyant devotional folk-pop. Supply the complete chapter. Do not claim autonomous refrain selection: the earlier Advanced-mode test did not demonstrate it. Repetition still requires an explicit run-level mode.

variations.label: Gentle shuffle
variations.direction: Light swung acoustic/piano groove, restrained percussion, clear unhurried scripture phrasing and buoyant forward motion. Experimental treatment within Upbeat; verify genre fit.

variations.label: Percussion-led lift
variations.direction: Tasteful shaker, tambourine and hand percussion give rhythmic identity, supported by acoustic guitar, piano and melodic bass. Keep the vocal clear and avoid relentless density.

variations.label: Solo with selective harmony
variations.direction: One stable lead singer; a supporting voice adds simultaneous harmony only at selected musical lifts. No repeated words by default; save singer roles and section assignments.
